links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified responses (ChatGPT and evidence-based online PCOS responses before simplification)
links.outcome: Readability of PCOS patient education responses
links.effect: Using ChatGPT to simplify the responses resulted in significant improvement in readability; no numeric values reported in the abstract. Before simplification, there were no statistically significant readability differences between ChatGPT and evidence-based responses.
links.quote: However, using ChatGPT for simplifying the responses resulted in significant improvement.
